MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

3. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   B. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   D. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.

4. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.

5. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

6. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.

7. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   C. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.

11. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   C. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instrument Indigenous musical instruments (fiddle, lyr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Apprecia and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Western Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. B — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. C — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instrument Indigenous musical instruments (fiddle, lyr; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Apprecia; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Musical Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
